name: Sonogi Ritsu
source:
"As for me... I can handle things on my own."

Kazuya's childhood friend, classmate, and neighbor. He always looks somewhat sulky around him. A serious model student who can't say "no" when someone asks him for help.

His father is away from home on a business trip, so he practically lives alone. He eats dinner at the Kadokura household almost every day.

[Translated from [url=https://nenaico.com/samaao/chara02.html]official website[/url]]
